description: Public registers of the La Flèche pages of the Historical Libraries Project: works, their witnesses, studies, comparisons with Hume, open questions in the project's records, and the coverage counts. Each value is shown as the site's pages show it. The texts the pages name are working machine-read texts produced by optical character recognition; they have not been verified against the page images and are not editions. One row per indexed work: the works with a page, then the works selected and not yet processed (these have no page, and only what the works index shows of them is given). These pages record textual relations that may warrant historical investigation. They are not evidence that Hume read, used, borrowed from, recalled or replied to any of these books. To cite the site, see the About / Citation page.
